questions.question: A alone can finish a task in 30 days. He works for 6 days on the same task and then B finishes it in 24 days. In how many days can A and B together finish the task?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can alone finish a task = 30 days

For the same task, A works for = 6 days and B works for = 24 days

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the number of days taken by B to complete the work be x.

⇒ Work done by A = (6)/(30)

⇒ Work done by B = (24)/(x)

⇒ (6)/(30)+(24)/(x) = 1

⇒ (24)/(x)=1-(1)/(5)

⇒ (24)/(x)=(4)/(5)

⇒ x = (24times 5)/(4) = 6 × 5 = 30 days

⇒ Adding efficiency of both A and B,

⇒ (1)/(30)+(1)/(30) = (2)/(30)

⇒ A and B can finish the task together in = (30)/(2) = 15 days

**Therefore, A and B together can finish the task in 15 days**.

questions.question: Sachin covers a certain distance by car driving at 80 km/h and he returns to the starting point riding on a scooter at 50 km/h. Find his average speed for the whole journey up to 2 decimal places.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**61.54 km/h.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Formula used- **

 
 
• Speed= Distance/Time
 
 
 
• **Given-** 
 
 
• Speed= 80Km/hr and 50 Km/hr
 
 
 
• **Calculation- **
 
 
• Let the distance be D Km. 
 
• So, time is taken to cover the distance= D/80 hr. 
 
• And, time is taken for return journey= D/50 hr. 
 
• Total time taken = (D/80) + (D/50) = (8D+5D)/(400)= 13D/400
 
• Total distance= D+D= 2D
 
• Average speed= Total distance/ Total Time taken= 2D/(13D/400)= 800/13= 61.5384 ≈ 61.54 (Ans).

questions.question: If the side of a square is tripled, then the ratio of the area of the resulting square to that of original square is:

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Dividend = 124, 307 and 243

Remainders = 4, 7 and 3

**Concept Used:**

Prime Factorization

**Calculation:**

⇒ On division, 124, 307 and 243 leaves remainders 4, 7 and 3 respectively.

⇒ Subtracting the remainder from the numbers, we get

124 – 4 = 120,

307 – 7 = 300,

243 – 3 = 240

⇒ Now, required greatest number is the HCF of 120, 300 and 240.

⇒ Factoring the numbers, we get

⇒ 120 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ 300 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 × 5

⇒ 240 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ HCF = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 = 60

**Therefore, the greatest number that divides 124, 307 and 243, leaving remainders 4, 7 and 3 is 60.**

questions.question: Ram alone can finish a task in 20 days while Shyam alone can finish it in 30 days. How many days will they take to finish the task if they work together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Ram to finish the work = 20 days

Time taken by Shyam to finish the work = 30 days

**Concept Used:**

Per day work = 1 ÷ Efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work done by Ram in one day = (1)/(20) units

⇒ Work done by Shyam in one day = (1)/(30) units

⇒ If they work together,

⇒ Efficiency to finish the work = (1)/(20)+(1)/(30)

⇒ Efficiency to finish the work = (3+2)/(60)=(5)/(60)

⇒ Efficiency to finish the complete work = (1)/(12)

⇒ Time taken by both to complete the work = 12 days

**Therefore, while working together Ram and Shyam take 12 days to complete the work.**
